title: Extension by zero preserves integral constructibility and localizing categories
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion.

1. $j_!$ is exact, preserves all direct sums, preserves all limits, and
   commutes with reduction modulo $\pi_E^n$.
2. $j_!$ maps $\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E)$ into $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.
3. $j_!$ maps $\Loc(\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E))$ into $\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))$.

proof.text: (1) Work in the separated finite-type $k$-scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. By [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine], $X$ and $U$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so [det-sf-open-closed-extension-zero-limits] applies to $A_X=\mathcal O_{E,X}$. Clause (1) of [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] identifies $j^{-1}A_X$ with $A_U$, and [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme] supplies the reduced complement. The ringed-site lemma [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed] gives exactness and $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$ on module sheaves. Using [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed], [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], and [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], these are the module categories of the item; [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] identifies module pullback with $j^{-1}$. By uniqueness of left adjoints, this is the module $j_!$ of [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. Exactness gives the termwise triangulated derived functor by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization].

source.place: proof (1), coefficient identification and exact derived factorization

proof.text: (2) The sheaf adjunction in (1) and [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits] give sheaf sums. By [det-def-localizing-closure-existence] (1), derived sums are termwise, so the termwise derived $j_!$ preserves them. Clause (2) of [det-sf-open-closed-extension-zero-limits] gives products and sequential derived inverse limits. For a small diagram $M$ with an existing categorical limit $L$, form the two products $P,Q$, which exist on $U$ as termwise product complexes by [det-pe-products-derived], and the maps $s,t$ of [lem-cor-int-compactness-ii-products-kernels-preserve-limits]. The limit maps give $k:L\to P$. Put $d=s-t$. A map $a:T\to P$ satisfies $da=0$ exactly when its components are a compatible family for $M$; the universal property of $L$ gives its unique factorization through $k$. Thus $k$ is a kernel of $d$. By [lem-cor-int-compactness-ii-pretriangulated-kernel-split], $j_!k$ is a kernel of $j_!d$. Additivity gives $j_!d=j_!s-j_!t$, so this is an equalizer of $j_!s,j_!t$. Product preservation identifies their components with the two canonical maps for $j_!M$; [lem-cor-int-compactness-ii-products-kernels-preserve-limits] proves the image cone limiting. This means all existing small categorical limits, without asserting completeness of the derived category. On module sheaves, products exist and are sectionwise by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-limits-sectionwise], clause (3) of [det-sf-open-closed-extension-zero-limits] supplies their preservation and exactness from (1) supplies kernels; the same product/equalizer construction gives all small limits.

source.place: proof (1), sums, products, and arbitrary limits

proof.text: (3) For $n=0$, reduction is tensoring with the zero coefficient ring, so both sides are zero. For $n\ge1$, [det-pe-derived-nakayama-resolution] identifies reduction modulo $\pi_E^n$ with the cone of multiplication by $\pi_E^n$. The $\mathcal O_E$-linear termwise functor in (1) preserves this cone: its terms, finite sums, differentials and scalar multiplication are carried to those of the cone on $j_!K$. Naturality holds term by term. On the two-term rank-one resolutions, the transition from $n+1$ to $n$ is multiplication by $\pi_E$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$; $j_!$ preserves these maps. Thus reduction and its transitions commute with $j_!$.

(4) If $K\in\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E)$, [sk-lem-int-tensor] states that extension by zero along a quasi-compact open immersion preserves $\Dbc$ for integral coefficients. Hence $j_!K\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$.

(5) In the ambient derived category let $\mathcal S$ be the full subcategory of $K$ with $j_!K\in\Loc(\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E))$. Exactness from (1) closes it under shifts and distinguished triangles, and sums from (2) close it under small sums; it is replete, hence localizing. By (4) it contains $\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E)$. Minimality in [det-def-localizing-closure-existence] (2) gives $\Loc(\Dbc(U,\mathcal O_E))\subseteq\mathcal S$.
